newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Oil sees 96/97 net 15 bln rupees. [CORRECTED 12:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Indian Oil sees 96/97 net 15 bln rupees. [CORRECTED 12:20 GMT]

text.p: (Company corrects profit forecast in headline and text to 15 bln rupees after tax from 18 bln rupees, the figure before tax.)

Indian Oil Corporation, the country's state-controlled oil refiner, expects to earn a net profit of around 15 billion rupees for the year 1996/97 (April/March) against 12.49 billion in the previous year, an official said.
"The profit before tax is expected to be around 18 billion rupees and the profit after tax is around 15 billion rupees," the spokesman said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Indian Oil finance director S.C. Mathur told a news conference that the firm expected 1996/97 net profit to be around 18 billion rupees.
The spokesman said Mathur was referring to pre-tax profit, not net profit. "This is a clarification," the spokesman told Reuters.
